title: Brent Emergency Help Points
summary: Emergency health facilities, urgent treatment locations, water hazard zones, and essential shops in Brent.
content:
For life-threatening emergencies, call 999 or 112 immediately.

1. Nearest 24-Hour A&E Hospitals
- Northwick Park Hospital: Watford Road, Harrow HA1 3UJ. From Wembley Central station: take bus 182 or 223 north along Watford Road (~25 mins), or drive 3 miles north-west.
- St Mary's Hospital (Major Trauma Centre): Praed Street, Paddington W2 1NY. From Kilburn High Road station: take bus 16 or 98 south along Edgware Road directly towards Paddington (~25 mins).

2. Urgent Treatment Centres
- Central Middlesex Hospital Urgent Treatment Centre: Acton Lane, Park Royal NW10 7NS. From Harlesden station: ~15 min walk south along Acton Lane (~0.7 miles), or take bus 187, 224, or 260 (~5 mins).
- Willesden Centre for Health and Care: Robson Avenue, Willesden NW10 3RY. From Willesden Green station: ~15 min walk west via High Road and Robson Avenue (~0.8 miles), or take bus 260 or 460.

3. Local Hazards
- Flood risk zones lie along the River Brent and Wealdstone Brook, particularly around Neasden, Wembley Stadium industrial lowlands, and surrounding the Brent Reservoir (Welsh Harp).

4. Essential Supplies
- Pharmacies and supermarkets situated along Wembley High Road, Kilburn High Road, and Harlesden High Street provide clean water, non-perishable rations, and basic medical supplies.

Note: addresses and opening hours may have changed — confirm on arrival where possible.
